says: The runner makes `interrupted` with Schema `make` from the writer meta, which carries strings decoded more loosely than `From` requires.
proof: In: `from()` at next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:725-733 copies `process.owner.key` and `for` (only `Schema.String` in `Writer`, next/packages/libfabrika/src/access/SessionManager.ts:26-29) and the span's trace id into a `From`, whose `by`, `for` and `build` are `Text` and whose `traceId` is a 32-hex `TraceId` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/ledger/Log.ts:29-56). Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:1375 `SupervisorMsg.cases.interrupted.make({ ...attempt, reason: interrupted, from: meta, at })`, whose `from` is `From` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/internal/supervisor.ts:180).
cost: A value that fails the made schema, from a Project answer or the stored descriptor, now dies as a defect in the runner's generator. Before #1619 the plain literal went into `send` or `complete`, whose `Effect.try` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:771-774) turned the supervisor's own make into a typed `bad_row`. Every producer today is fabrika's own code, so it takes version skew between objects or a corrupt row.
